extract_symbols_from_library: extract symbols from a shared library using readelf or nm and return a filtered unique list
create_NMExtractor_for_nm: create an NMExtractor instance to extract symbols from a library using the nm command line tool
create_ReadElfExtractor_for_readelf: create a ReadElfExtractor instance to extract symbols from a library using the readelf command line tool
review_NMExtractor_extract_sym: review the NMExtractor _extract_sym method that parses nm output lines into symbol dictionaries with name type and size
review_ReadElfExtractor_process_syms: review the ReadElfExtractor process_syms method that parses readelf dynamic symbol table output into symbol dictionaries
